 {"title":"A right triangle","say":"Take a right triangle with legs a and b and hypotenuse c. The hypotenuse is the side opposite the right angle.","ops":[

   {"op":"write","id":"lab-c","x":360,"y":480,"text":"c","size":36,"color":"red"}]},
 {"title":"Squares on the sides","say":"Build a square on each side. Its area is the side length squared, so the squares have areas a², b² and c².","ops":[
   {"op":"rect","id":"sq-a","x":300,"y":560,"w":240,"h":240,"color":"blue","width":3,"fill":"blue"},
   {"op":"rect","id":"sq-b","x":60,"y":380,"w":240,"h":180,"color":"green","width":3,"fill":"green"},
   {"op":"path","id":"sq-c","d":"M300,380 L540,560 L720,320 L480,140 Z","color":"red","width":3,"fill":"red"},

   {"op":"write","id":"area-c","x":510,"y":330,"text":"c²","size":44,"anchor":"middle"}]},
 {"title":"A big square","say":"Now draw a square with side a + b. Its area is (a + b)², which we can also count in another way.","ops":[

   {"op":"write","id":"big-label","x":1010,"y":150,"text":"side a + b","size":34,"anchor":"middle"}]},
 {"title":"Four copies of the triangle","say":"Put four copies of the triangle into the corners of the big square. Each copy has legs a and b.","ops":[
   {"op":"path","id":"t1","d":"M800,200 L1040,200 L800,380 Z","color":"blue","width":4,"fill":"blue"},
   {"op":"path","id":"t2","d":"M1040,200 L1220,200 L1220,440 Z","color":"blue","width":4,"fill":"blue"},

   {"op":"path","id":"t4","d":"M800,620 L980,620 L800,380 Z","color":"blue","width":4,"fill":"blue"}]},
 {"title":"The square left in the middle","say":"The four triangles leave a tilted square in the middle. Its side is the hypotenuse c, so its area is c².","ops":[
   {"op":"path","id":"inner","d":"M1040,200 L1220,440 L980,620 L800,380 Z","color":"red","width":4,"fill":"red"},
   {"op":"write","id":"inner-label","x":1010,"y":385,"text":"c²","size":44,"anchor":"middle"}]},
 {"title":"Count the area two ways","say":"The big square's area is (a + b)² and also four triangles plus c². Both count the same area, so the a and b terms must match up and leave c² = a² + b².","ops":[
   {"op":"erase","region":{"x":40,"y":100,"w":560,"h":760}},
   {"op":"write","id":"eq1","x":60,"y":300,"text":"Big square: (a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b²","size":36},
   {"op":"write","id":"eq2","x":60,"y":380,"text":"Four triangles + c²: 4·(ab/2) + c² = 2ab + c²","size":36},
   {"op":"write","id":"eq3","x":60,"y":480,"text":"Both equal the same area, so","size":36},
   {"op":"write","id":"eq4","x":60,"y":540,"text":"a² + b² = c²","size":56,"color":"blue","underline":true}]}
]}
